summary: OpenGL and shared-surface handling was tightened for VA-API video textures, ensuring only actual image content is blitted instead of copying unrelated texture areas. Firefox also avoids unsafe framebuffer ownership assumptions, improves Metal synchronization when exporting or snapshotting Canvas surfaces, and disables Android ANGLE surface paths that are not reliable. These are mostly behind-the-scenes fixes aimed at preventing corrupted output and improving cross-platform stability.
